basic_details.job_title: CMRU Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CMR University's Directorate of Research and Innovation (DORI) is inviting applications for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship, January 2027, from Ph.D. holders whose degree was awarded within the five years preceding the date of application. Selected Full-Time fellows receive ₹70,000 per month for one year. Applications are accepted through the CMR University portal from 25 November 2026 to 8 January 2027, and the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview is scheduled for 18–23 January 2027.

how_to_apply: Submit the prescribed application form along with supporting documents through the CMR University portal before the deadline of 8 January 2027.
Include a research proposal, as its submission is mandatory.
Wait for the shortlist notification, due on 14 January 2027. Shortlisted candidates are informed about the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview and the subsequent selection process.
For further details, contact the Directorate of Research and Innovation, CMR University, at [email protected]. The notice does not print the portal address or the form's location.
Shortlisted candidates must carry one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents for submission at the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview:
Original UGC-NET or similar national-level test scorecard, if applicable
Proof of date of birth (HSC/HSSC certificate or marks statement)
Details of research and development projects completed
Details of Ph.D. scholars guided, if applicable

content_sections.heading: About CMRU
content_sections.text: CMR University is based in Bengaluru, and its admin office is at #2, 3rd 'C' Cross, 6th 'A' Main HRBR Layout, 2nd Block, Kalyana Nagar, Bengaluru 560043, India. The fellowship is offered through its Directorate of Research and Innovation (DORI). It is meant to support researchers with strong academic and research credentials in independent research, scholarly publication and collaborative academic activities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree awarded within the five years preceding the date of application. International candidates may also apply. The fellowship is open to scholars in these disciplines: Physics Mathematics Computer Science and Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Information Technology Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Data Science Computer Applications Management Economics and Commerce Law Applications are considered under Full-Time, Part-Time and Remote Mode, subject to the applicable fellowship provisions and University guidelines. Part-Time and Remote Mode fellows must conduct their research under the supervision of CMR University faculty and fulfil the prescribed research publication requirements. The notice prints no age limit and no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each area.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected Full-Time fellows receive a fellowship of ₹70,000 per month for one year. The fellowship may be extended annually, subject to a review of the fellow's performance and research potential. Part-Time and Remote Mode fellows are not entitled to the monthly Post-Doctoral Fellowship. They may be considered for publication incentives, project-based honoraria, patent incentives, or other research-performance-based rewards, as notified by the University from time to time.

content_sections.heading: CMRU Post-Doctoral Fellowship Job Description
content_sections.text: The fellowship encourages independent research and measurable academic outcomes. Fellows are expected to: Publish a minimum of three research papers during the fellowship period in journals indexed in Scopus, SCI/SCIE, ABDC or ABS, as applicable, with CMR University affiliation. Publish in qualifying journal categories: Scopus Q1/Q2, ABDC A/B or ABS 4/3, as applicable. Be the first author or corresponding author of each qualifying publication. Publish at least one paper in a Scopus Q1, ABDC A or ABS 4 journal, as applicable. Full-Time fellows receiving financial assistance are also expected to: Undertake collaborative research proposals for external funding. Mentor students. Contribute a minimum of 8 hours or 2 courses per week of academic teaching. Maintain research integrity and comply with research ethics and plagiarism rules. Obtain required approvals and adhere to University attendance and leave procedures.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMRU Post-Doctoral Fellowship
content_sections.text: Submit the prescribed application form along with supporting documents through the CMR University portal before the deadline of 8 January 2027. Include a research proposal, as its submission is mandatory. Wait for the shortlist notification, due on 14 January 2027. Shortlisted candidates are informed about the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview and the subsequent selection process. For further details, contact the Directorate of Research and Innovation, CMR University, at [email protected] . The notice does not print the portal address or the form's location. Shortlisted candidates must carry one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents for submission at the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview: Original UGC-NET or similar national-level test scorecard, if applicable Proof of date of birth (HSC/HSSC certificate or marks statement) Qualifying degree certificates (UG/PG/Ph.D.) Copies/details of journal publications Details of research and development projects completed Caste certificate, if applicable Experience certificate(s), if applicable Details of Ph.D. scholars guided, if applicable One recent passport-size photograph Aadhaar card PAN card

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting is based on the applicant's research profile, innovation, and the potential outcomes of the proposed research. The shortlist is to be notified on 14 January 2027. Shortlisted candidates then attend the Research Proposal Presentation/Interview, scheduled for 18–23 January 2027. The notice does not describe marks, weightage or the interview venue.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMRU Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 8 January 2027. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for the CMR University Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree awarded within the five years preceding the date of application. International candidates may also apply.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Selected Full-Time fellows receive ₹70,000 per month for one year. The fellowship may be extended annually, subject to a review of performance and research potential.

faq.question: Q4. Do Part-Time and Remote Mode fellows get the monthly fellowship?
faq.answer: No, Part-Time and Remote Mode fellows are not entitled to the monthly fellowship. They may be considered for publication incentives, project-based honoraria, patent incentives or other research-performance-based rewards, as notified by the University.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed application form with supporting documents through the CMR University portal by 8 January 2027, including a research proposal, which is mandatory.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is based on the research profile, innovation and potential outcomes of the proposed research. Shortlisted candidates attend a Research Proposal Presentation/Interview.

faq.question: Q7. When will the shortlist and the interview take place?
faq.answer: The shortlist notification is due on 14 January 2027. The Research Proposal Presentation/Interview is scheduled for 18–23 January 2027.

faq.question: Q8. How many papers must a fellow publish?
faq.answer: Fellows must publish a minimum of three research papers with CMR University affiliation, as first or corresponding author. At least one must be in a Scopus Q1, ABDC A or ABS 4 journal, as applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Which disciplines are covered?
faq.answer: The fellowship covers Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Applications, Management, Economics and Commerce, and Law.

faq.question: Q10. What teaching work do Full-Time fellows have to do?
faq.answer: Full-Time fellows receiving financial assistance must contribute a minimum of 8 hours or 2 courses per week of academic teaching, mentor students and undertake collaborative research proposals for external funding.
